lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four parallel horizontal rows across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a rectilinear grid-like configuration.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from high (superior) to low (inferior).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a high-density cluster of high-luminance blobs of varying diameters distributed across the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A circular high-contrast feature with an attached linear probe is located on the dorsal ridge, indicating an artificial attachment (satellite tag).
other_distinctive_markers: Proximity of a high-luminance artificial structure (human limb and pole) overlaying the dorsal-lateral region.
